'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Oi, come here, need to talk to you. Got a job for you, a dry one, if you ask me. My folks were looking for loot at night recently and ran into some hooded morons, and, well, shit went south. Naturally, my dudes managed to retreat in the end and even smoked some of those psychos, though we still lost around a dozen of ours. Eh, that's not the point. The guys found some kind of a dagger on one of those psychos, and apparently, some serious people are willing to pay a fortune for those. Anyway, I've got an order for those daggers. If you find any, bring'em here.}}

==Requirements== 
* Obtain level 4 loyalty with [[Skier]]

==Objectives==
* Obtain 12 [[Cultist knife|unusual knives]]
* Hand over 12 [[Cultist knife|knives]] to [[Skier]]
* Eliminate 5 [[Cultists|hooded men]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 2,400 Euros
** 2,520 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 2,760 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle]]
* 5× [[7.62x39mm PP gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle]] at [[Skier]] LL4
* Unlocks purchase of [[Magpul MOE Carbine rubber buttpad]] at [[Skier]] LL4
* +4 [[Search|Search skill]] levels
* +4 [[Stress Resistance|Stress Resistance skill]] levels
{{quote|Bloody hell... You got them all by yourself? You've got guts, that's for sure. Somethin' ain't right about those psychos, I'm tellin' you...}}
